annotations.title: Get ICRIS Statutory Filing Dossier Index

description: Retrieve the full catalog of official ICRIS statutory filed documents for a Hong Kong company (works without an API key), including authentic ICRIS barcodes, form codes (NAR1, NNC1, ND2A, A&A, etc.), filing dates, official document titles, and retrieval fees. Barcodes can be passed to create_filing_order to retrieve official PDFs.

api_key.description: Optional 86hc.com MCP API key (format: hkq_live_xxxx). Omit or leave empty to use the automatic Guest IP Trial Mode (3 free company detail queries/day + direct Stripe filing orders without a key). Free API key with 20 daily company queries available at https://www.86hc.com/user

company_name.description: Exact company name in English or Chinese.

cr_no.description: Hong Kong Company CR Number (1-7 digits).

form_code.description: Optional form code filter (e.g. NAR1, NNC1, ND2A, AA). Leave empty for all filings.

identifier.description: Target Hong Kong company CR number (1-7 digits), 8-digit BRN, or exact company name.

name: get_company_filings
